title: Limit-Review Fee Part: Cartwise Grocery Orders Definition
content:
**Limit-review fee part** (Cartwise Grocery Orders). A service-fee part is added to the claim value of a customer's limit-review claim, and it is set by how the order's service fee was billed:

- when the order carries a service-fee waiver from the member service-fee rate and a Cartwise+ plan is recorded on the order, the fee part is the claim value times the member service-fee rate of that plan (the percentage the Cartwise+ Membership plan states), rounded to the cent;
- when the order carries no such waiver but a service fee is billed, it is the claim value times the service fee billed divided by the order's item subtotal (the sum of its billed item lines), rounded to the cent;
- otherwise there is none.

The waiver is read from the order's fee waiver entries whose basis is the member service-fee rate; the service fee billed from its service fee charge entry; the plan and its member service-fee rate from the Cartwise+ Membership recorded on the order.

### Truth table

| Member-rate waiver | Plan recorded | Service fee billed | Fee part |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | any | claim value times the plan's member service-fee rate |
| yes | no | any | none |
| no | any | yes | claim value times fee billed divided by item subtotal |
| no | any | no | none |

### Hypothetical figures (claim value 14.60)

- Member order, member-rate waiver present, plan rate a hypothetical 4 percent: 14.60 times 4 percent is 0.584, rounded to 0.58.
- Non-member order, service fee 4.50 billed on an item subtotal of 60.00: 14.60 times 4.50 divided by 60.00 is 1.095, rounded to 1.10.
- Order with no member-rate waiver and no service fee billed: no fee part.
